comparison_plan.actual: Stata ATT(2,2), methods ipw and dr, and every SE
comparison_plan.note: Approved ill-conditioning divergence (reports/postestimation-display-audit-2026-08-31.md): with a propensity-score hessian condition number near 1e14 the two logit solvers agree to about 5e-5 in the ATT; the reg ATT is stable to 1e-9 and is compared at TOL002; the ipw and dr ATTs are bounded at 1e-3 absolute and every SE at 1e-3 relative (measured gaps: 3e-5 in an ATT, 1e-4 relative in an SE). The same model with x2 dropped is 1e-2 away for ipw and 2.6e-3 for dr, so the bound separates the specified model from a re-specified one.

scope_note: 300-unit two-period panel, cohort 2 against never-treated units, covariates x1 and x2 = x1 + 10^(-k/10) z, universal base, analytical inference; k = 65 and k = 68, methods reg, ipw and dr.
